title: 第十四章 剑下无错第十五章 名声鹊起
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
接下来几天林阳悠闲的逛着茂陵，没有着急去找“剑下无错”王绩。
好不容易穿越了，脑子里只有打打杀杀多无趣，多见见异世界风土人情，品尝一番当地特色美食也是好的。
这天，林阳将房间退掉，整了整衣物背负玄黑剑鞘迈步离开客栈。
游玩几天是时候登上人榜了。他这几天已经打听到了王绩所住的客栈。
走在宽敞的大街上，林阳内心古井无波，一个九窍都未开的人，不值得他在意。
若非王绩学得《堪虚剑法》，林阳都不一定会前去寻他。
……
凉春客栈，一层大厅吵闹繁杂，江湖人士三三两两的坐在一起，谈论奇闻异事。
一个三十出头的瘦脸男子，一口将杯中酒饮尽，开口道：“听说了吗？有人一朝登上人榜。”
“前日从塞外归来，未关注人榜变更。”
同桌的汉子摇了摇头。他粗布麻衣，手上一层厚厚的老茧，腰间一柄短刀，看上去是一名刀客。
仿佛是意料之中，瘦脸男子自得的笑了笑，炫耀道：“据传玄天宗杰出弟子清余下山历练，于衡州偶遇‘裂空血手’，激战数十招，最终一刀‘金皇碎红尘’将‘裂空血手’斩于刀下，震动衡州。”
“裂空血手”元狈，江湖草莽出身，一手“赤玄爪”使得炉火纯青，七窍，人榜排名第四十三。
“‘裂空血手’被杀了？”
刀客汉子一脸震惊，没想到自身不过离开中原数日，就发生这等大事。
别看人榜第四十三排名不高，但是认真想想就知道，全天下的年轻一代才能有五十人上榜，哪怕是其中末尾，放在一郡之地都是同辈难逢敌手的天才人物。
“没错，这一次人榜更新后，玄天宗清余可能直接位列前四十。”
瘦脸男子的消息比较灵通，能早于群众知道一些内部消息。
“六扇门给他的称号？”
刀客看向自家同伴。曾经他也梦想登上人榜名扬天下，结果碌碌无为十几年，被岁月磨平了棱角。

“五方帝刀。”瘦脸男子接着说道：“玄天宗有绝学《五方五帝刀法》，六扇门给的称号可能就由此而来。”
“想来那‘五方帝刀’磨砺几年，必能问鼎人榜前十。”
刀客眼中露出一抹艳羡，他闯荡江湖多年，所学也不过一门蓄气级数的五虎断门刀，距离那《五方五帝刀法》差了不知凡几。
“可惜无缘能见人榜争锋。”
瘦脸男子神色遗憾。
就在这时，客栈外传来了年轻男性的声音：“‘剑下无错’可在？林阳特来挑战。”
平平淡淡的一句话，压下了客栈的喧嚣，彰显出此人浑厚的功力。
瘦脸男子愕然看向大门处，就见一位二十左右，身着蓝色劲装的青年背负玄黑剑鞘走进客栈。
人榜第三十五的剑下无错王绩就住在此间客栈？怎么从未听人提及过？
他内心满是疑惑，接着又呢喃道：“林阳是何人？”
绞尽脑汁都没有想到关于林阳的一丝一毫信息，仿佛这人是横空出世。功力如此不凡不该是籍籍无名之辈才对。
“我归来后倒是听闻过，不知何人放出的风声，此人虽然还是开窍期，却是外景下第一高手。”
有常住在茂陵的人出声解释。
在寂静的大厅，他的声音非常显然，当时就有人嗤笑出声。
“外景之下第一高手？坐井观天之辈。”
开口的是一个二十六七的青绿袍青年。他讥讽道：“外景之下，不入人榜的半步外景者不知凡几，哪怕人榜第一的‘无形剑’何九都不敢此言。”
他的话让在场的江湖人士都赞同不已。他们承认这林阳功力深厚，恐怕内天地已然小成自成循环，但是说是外景下第一，却是不可能。
content_en:
Lin Yang spent the next few days leisurely strolling around Maoling, not in a hurry to find Wang Ji, the "sword-reading man".
After finally traveling through time, all I could think about was how boring it was to fight and kill. It would be good to see more of the customs and customs of a different world, and taste some local specialties.
On this day, Lin Yang checked out the room, straightened his clothes, and walked out of the inn with a black sword scabbard on his back.
After playing for a few days, it’s time to get on the list. He had already inquired about the inn where Wang Ji was staying in the past few days.
Walking on the spacious street, Lin Yang felt calm in his heart. A person who has not yet opened his eyes is not worthy of his attention.
If Wang Ji hadn't learned the "Kanxu Sword Technique", Lin Yang might not have gone to look for him.
…
The lobby on the first floor of Liangchun Inn is noisy and busy, with people from all walks of life sitting together in twos and threes, talking about strange things.
A thin-faced man in his early thirties drank the wine in one gulp and said, "Did you hear about it? Someone suddenly made it to the list."
"I returned from outside the Great Wall the day before yesterday and didn't pay attention to the changes in the list of people."
The man at the same table shook his head. He was dressed in coarse linen, had thick calluses on his hands, and had a short knife at his waist. He looked like a swordsman.
As if it was expected, the thin-faced man smiled complacently and showed off: "It is said that Qing Yu, an outstanding disciple of the Xuantian Sect, went down the mountain to practice. He encountered the 'Splitting Bloody Hand' by chance in Hengzhou. They fought with dozens of moves and finally killed the 'Splitting Bloody Hand' with the 'Golden Emperor Shattering Red Dust' sword, which shocked Hengzhou."
"Split Bloody Hand" Yuan Nong was born in a rough place in Jianghu. His "Red Mysterious Claw" made him extremely proficient, with seven orifices, and he ranked 43rd on the list of people.
"'Kong Xue Hand' was killed?"
The swordsman man looked shocked. He didn't expect that such a big thing would happen to him after he had only been away from the Central Plains for a few days.
Even though number 43 is not high on the list, if you think about it carefully, you will know that only fifty people from the younger generation in the world are on the list. Even if they are at the bottom of the list, they are geniuses who are hard to match in a county.
"That's right, after the list of people is updated this time, Xuantian Sect Qingyu may directly rank in the top forty."
The thin-faced man is relatively well-informed and can know some inside information earlier than the public.
"The title given to him by Six Doors?"
The swordsman looked at his companion. He once dreamed of being on the celebrity list and becoming famous all over the world, but he ended up doing nothing for more than ten years, and his edges were smoothed away by time.
"Five Directions Emperor Sword." The thin-faced man continued: "Xuan Tian Sect has a unique skill called "Five Directions and Five Emperors Sword Techniques", and the title given to him by the Six Sects may have come from this."
"I think after a few years of sharpening the 'Five Directions Emperor Sword', I will definitely be able to reach the top ten on the list."
There was a hint of envy in the swordsman's eyes. He had been wandering around the world for many years, but what he had learned was only the Five Tigers Door-Breaking Sword with a Qi accumulation level, which was far behind the "Five Directions and Five Emperors Sword Techniques".
"It's a pity that I don't have the opportunity to compete with others on the list."
The thin-faced man looked regretful.
At this moment, a young male's voice came from outside the inn: "Where is the 'No Wrong Under the Sword'? Lin Yangte is here to challenge."
The calm words suppressed the hustle and bustle of the inn and showed the man's strong skills.
The thin-faced man looked at the door in astonishment and saw a young man in his twenties, dressed in blue attire, walking into the inn with a black sword scabbard on his back.
Is Wang Ji, the thirty-fifth person on the list of swordsmen with no mistakes, staying in this inn? Why have I never heard anyone mention it?
He was full of doubts, and then murmured: "Who is Lin Yang?"
After racking his brains, he couldn't think of any information about Lin Yang, as if this person appeared out of nowhere. It shouldn't be for an unknown person to have such extraordinary skills.
"After I came back, I heard that someone had spread the rumor. Although this person is still in the awakening stage, he is the number one master in outdoor scenes."
Someone who lives in Maoling gave an explanation.
In the silent hall, his voice was very obvious, and some people laughed out loud.
"The number one master in outdoor scenes? The one who sits in a well and looks at the sky."
The one who spoke was a young man in his mid-twenties in green robes. He sarcastically said:"On location, there are so many people who are not on the list of half-step outsiders. Even the 'Invisible Sword' He Jiu, who is number one on the list, would not dare to say this."
His words made everyone present agree with him. They admitted that Lin Yang had profound skills, and he was afraid that the inner world had already formed its own cycle, but it was impossible to say that he was the best in the outdoor scene.
